title: TELEPORT PLAYER
features:
🟢 NEMO HUB TELEPORT V3 - SCRIPT DESCRIPTION
NEMO HUB Teleport V3 is a high-performance utility script for Roblox designed to enhance player navigation and server monitoring. Built with a focus on speed and a clean user interface, it provides essential tools for both casual and advanced users.
🚀 Core Functionalities
Instant Teleportation: Seamlessly move to any player's location using high-precision X, Y, Z coordinate mapping.
POV Spectate Mode: View the game through the eyes of other players by locking your camera to their character.
Target ESP (Highlights): Toggle a bright Cyan aura around players to track their movement through walls and obstacles.
Smart Friend Finder: Automatically detects and bookmarks your Roblox friends when they join the server.
Coordinate Saver: Save your current position in the world and return to it instantly at any time.
🛠 Technical Features
Optimized Engine: Uses task.wait and event-based connections to ensure zero lag, even on low-end mobile devices.
Search & Filter: Advanced search bar to quickly find players by their Display Name or Username.
Auto-Update: Hosted on GitHub via loadstring, ensuring you always run the latest, bug-fixed version.
Clean UI: A modern, dark-themed interface that can be toggled on/off to keep your screen clear.
